_readme: weeks: one theme per week, keyed by the week's SUNDAY (YYYY-MM-DD); shown as 'This week: <theme>' and in the share text. schedule: the planned rotation (theme + Sunday date). The page uses a scheduled theme once that week has daily entries, so the theme changes by itself each Sunday. days: one entry per date (YYYY-MM-DD). side: the day's angle on the week's theme; shown small under 'This week: …' and as the 'Tomorrow:' teaser after the quiz. It must say only what the 3 verses say. verses: 1 OT then 2 NT, copied word for word from the public-domain text (never print a translation label on the page). quiz: one question per verse ('verse' is the verse index, 'answer' is the index of the right choice). commentary: null, or {text, father, work, source_url} from a 1st–3rd century Church Father, verified in a public-domain source; shown under the verses only when filled in. See README.md. glossary: shared list of truly archaic words and plain meanings (a value can be "meaning" or {"word": "Shown form", "means": "meaning"}); the page lists, under each verse, only the glossary words found in it.

glossary.loins: the waist (here, the mind made ready)

verses.text: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

quiz.q: In Psalm 16:11, what is in God’s presence?
In Acts 2:28, with what does God make me full of joy?
In Romans 15:13, the God of hope fills you with all joy and what?

verses.text: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

quiz.q: In Isaiah 12:3, from which wells do we draw water with joy?
In Luke 1:47, in whom does my spirit rejoice?
In Luke 2:10, what did the angel bring?

verses.text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

quiz.q: In Psalm 30:5, when does joy come?
In James 1:2, when should we count it all joy?
In 1 Peter 4:13, we rejoice as partakers of what?

verses.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

quiz.q: In Psalm 126:5, what do they that sow in tears reap?
In John 16:20, what shall your sorrow be turned into?
In John 16:22, who can take your joy from you?

verses.text: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

quiz.q: In Psalm 100:2, how should we serve the LORD?
In 2 Corinthians 8:2, what did they have in a great trial of affliction?
In 2 Corinthians 9:7, what kind of giver does God love?

verses.text: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

quiz.q: In Nehemiah 8:10, what is the joy of the LORD?
In John 15:11, what does Jesus want to remain in you?
In 1 John 1:4, what may your joy be?

verses.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
Rejoice evermore.

quiz.q: In Psalm 118:24, what will we do in the day the LORD hath made?
In Philippians 4:4, how often should we rejoice in the Lord?
In 1 Thessalonians 5:16, how long should we rejoice?

2026-11-22.side: Our hope is in the Lord

verses.text: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

quiz.q: In Psalm 39:7, where is my hope?
In Romans 15:4, the things written aforetime were written for what?
In 1 Timothy 1:1, who is our hope?

commentary.text: Having then this hope, let our souls be bound to Him who is faithful in His promises, and just in His judgments.

verses.text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

quiz.q: In Psalm 31:24, whose heart shall he strengthen?
choices: All ye that hope in the LORD

quiz.q: In Romans 5:5, hope maketh not what?
In Hebrews 6:11, we should shew the same diligence to what?

commentary.text: Let us then continually persevere in our hope, and the earnest of our righteousness, which is Jesus Christ, who bore our sins in His own body on the tree, who did no sin, neither was guile found in His mouth, but endured all things for us, that we might live in Him.

verses.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

quiz.q: In Psalm 130:5, in his word do I what?
In Romans 8:24, we are saved by what?
In Romans 8:25, if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience what?

commentary.text: Let us therefore earnestly strive to be found in the number of those that wait for Him, in order that we may share in His promised gifts.

verses.text: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

quiz.q: In Lamentations 3:24, the LORD is my what?
In 1 Peter 1:3, he hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by what?
In 1 Peter 1:13, hope to the end for the grace brought unto you at what?

commentary.text: As our Master, therefore, did not at once depart, taking flight [to heaven], but awaited the time of His resurrection prescribed by the Father, which had been also shown forth through Jonas, and rising again after three days was taken up [to heaven]; so ought we also to await the time of our resurrection prescribed by God and foretold by the prophets, and so, rising, be taken up, as many as the Lord shall account worthy of this [privilege].

verses.text: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

quiz.q: In Psalm 147:11, those that fear him hope in what?
In 1 Peter 1:21, your faith and hope might be in whom?
In 2 Thessalonians 2:16, God hath given us good hope through what?

commentary.text: But He who raised Him up from the dead will raise us up also, if we do His will, and walk in His commandments, and love what He loved.

2026-11-27.side: Hope, an anchor of the soul

verses.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

quiz.q: In Psalm 42:5, the soul is told to hope in whom?
In Hebrews 6:19, which hope we have as what of the soul?
In Colossians 1:27, what is Christ in you called?

commentary.text: Who, in the midst of these things, is trembling and sad, except he who is without hope and faith?

2026-11-28.side: The blessed hope of his appearing

verses.text: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

quiz.q: In Psalm 130:7, with him is what?
In Romans 12:12, we are told to be rejoicing in what?
In Titus 2:13, we are looking for the glorious appearing of whom?
choices: The great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ

commentary.text: Of a truth, soon and suddenly shall His will be accomplished, as the Scripture also bears witness, saying, Speedily will He come, and will not tarry; and, The Lord shall suddenly come to His temple, even the Holy One, for whom you look.

verses.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

quiz.q: In Isaiah 26:3, whose mind is kept in perfect peace?
choices: He whose mind is stayed on thee

quiz.q: In John 14:27, the peace Jesus gives is not as what?
In 2 Thessalonians 3:16, the Lord of peace himself give you peace how?

commentary.text: Nothing is more precious than peace, by which all war, both in heaven and earth, is brought to an end.

verses.text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

quiz.q: In Isaiah 53:5, what was upon him?
In Romans 5:1, being justified by faith, we have peace with God through whom?
In Colossians 1:20, he made peace through what?

commentary.text: Thus a profound and abundant peace was given to you all, and you had an insatiable desire for doing good, while a full outpouring of the Holy Spirit was upon you all.

2026-12-01.side: Peace in him, even in trouble

verses.text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

quiz.q: In Psalm 29:11, the LORD will bless his people with what?
In John 16:33, in the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; for what?
In Philippians 4:7, the peace of God shall keep your hearts and minds through whom?

commentary.text: Let us then be imitators of His patience; and if we suffer for His name's sake, let us glorify Him.

verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

quiz.q: In Psalm 34:14, after we seek peace, what should we do?
In Romans 14:19, let us follow after the things which make for what?
In Hebrews 12:14, follow peace with all men, and what else?

commentary.text: Wherefore, having so many great and glorious examples set before us, let us turn again to the practice of that peace which from the beginning was the mark set before us.

2026-12-03.side: The fruit of righteousness is peace

verses.text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

quiz.q: In Isaiah 32:17, the work of righteousness shall be what?
In Matthew 5:9, the peacemakers shall be called what?
In James 3:18, the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of whom?

commentary.text: Let us cleave, therefore, to those who cultivate peace with godliness, and not to those who hypocritically profess to desire it.

verses.text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

quiz.q: In Psalm 119:165, great peace have they which love what?
In Colossians 3:15, let what rule in your hearts?
In Ephesians 2:14, he is our what?

commentary.text: Let nothing exist among you that may divide you; but be united with your bishop, and those that preside over you, as a type and evidence of your immortality.

verses.text: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

quiz.q: In Numbers 6:26, the LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee what?
In Luke 2:14, glory to God in the highest, and on earth what?
In 2 Corinthians 13:11, live in peace; and who shall be with you?
choices: The God of love and peace

commentary.text: All these the great Creator and Lord of all has appointed to exist in peace and harmony; while He does good to all, but most abundantly to us who have fled for refuge to His compassions through Jesus Christ our Lord, to whom be glory and majesty for ever and ever. Amen.
